verses.text: Christ suffered in his body, so you also must be ready to suffer, with the same attitude he had. Anyone who has suffered in their body is finished with sin.
So they no longer live the rest of their life on earth for wrong human desires, but for what God wants.

You have already spent enough time in the past doing what people who do not know God like to do. You lived in sexual sin and wrong desires, getting drunk, wild parties, drinking and worshipping idols, which God hates.
Now those people think it is strange that you no longer join them in their wild living, and they insult you.
But they will have to explain themselves to God, who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
That is why the good news was preached even to those who are now dead. They were judged in their bodies like all people, but they can live in the spirit, as God lives.
The end of all things is near. So think clearly and control yourselves, so that you can pray.
Most of all, love each other deeply, because love covers over many sins.
Welcome each other into your homes without complaining.
God has given each of you a gift. Use it to serve each other, taking good care of all the different ways God shows his kindness.

If anyone speaks, they should speak as if they are speaking God's very words. If anyone serves, they should serve with the strength God gives. Then God will be praised in everything through Jesus Christ. Glory and power belong to him forever and ever. Amen.
Dear friends, do not be surprised by the fiery troubles that have come to test you, as if something strange were happening to you.
Instead, be glad that you share in Christ's sufferings, so that you will be full of joy when his glory is shown.
If people insult you because you follow Christ, you are blessed, because the glorious Spirit of God rests on you. They speak evil of him, but you bring him glory.
None of you should suffer for being a murderer, a thief or someone who does evil, or for poking into other people's business.
But if you suffer for being a Christian, do not be ashamed. Praise God that you carry that name.
The time has come for judgment to begin with God's own family. And if it begins with us, what will happen to those who do not obey God's good news?
As the Scripture says, "If it is hard for good people to be saved, what will happen to those who do not care about God, and to sinners?"
So if you suffer because God allows it, keep doing good, and trust yourselves to God. He made you, and he will always be faithful.
